verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a government tax-filing service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The pack documents only a web portal, the MeinELSTER+ app, certificate-based authentication and a channel for third-party tax software (ERiC). Nothing shows an official MCP server or any agent-facing tool endpoint, and third-party software integration is an adjacent capability that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
